en: Yesterday's riddle: some months have thirty-one days, some have thirty. How many months have twenty-eight days?
February is not the only one! Every single month has at least twenty-eight days.
So all twelve months have twenty-eight days. The answer is twelve!
Person one watches a rooster climb up to the very top of a barn roof.
The rooster lays an egg, right on the peak. Will the egg roll down the left side, or the right side?
Person two says: left! Person three says: right!
So, which way does the egg roll?
Comment your answer. The answer drops tomorrow, at sunrise.
